title: toktier parity reading: the added-token literal segmentation column of one family
description: Per-family column of a native-front-end parity reading (CPU arm or GPU arm, named by the reading's schema) for documents that hold added-token literals: chat-shaped variants of the parity documents and the literal-dense battery, compared with the reference oracle. literal_class says whether the face is served by the native literal segmenter (served) or keeps the whole-document reference path (unserved). Each entry of entry_points is one measured entry point of the native router (id_route: the ID route; state_route: the session-state route), with per-document path classes, the bytes each engine encoded, and the guard documents (documents the engine guard sent whole to the reference). The vacuity guard is on bytes: on a served face the reference encodes bytes only inside the listed guard documents (segments.bytes.hf == guard_documents.bytes_hf), the guard-document count is bounded, and in the GPU arm some segment bytes reach the GPU (segments.bytes.gpu > 0, with gpu_share reported); otherwise a silent whole-document fallback would read as zero mismatches. hf_segments_below_crossover counts the documents of a served face on a route whose only backend after the GPU is the reference with every text segment below the GPU crossover: the reference encodes the whole document (code R_INPUT_ADDED_TOKEN, a case of its own, so hf_added_token on a served face stays 0); such documents are listed in below_crossover_documents with their bytes, which count toward segments.bytes.hf beside the guard documents, and they occur only in the GPU arm. added_frontend_fingerprint names the added-token table the reading was taken on and has to equal the registry record's. Checked by tools/check_reading_forms.py.

covered_literals.description: Divergence-set literals of carried records covered by the battery (informative).

paths.description: Per-document path classes; every document is counted once.

below_crossover_documents.description: Documents counted as hf_segments_below_crossover and the bytes the reference encoded for them (whole documents). Required when that count is above 0.
